summary: Gorax showcases a top-tier Dauntless team strategy against the Season 8 endgame boss Mekkatorque. The lineup consists of Guinavivre, Kurvida, Nastjenka, Selva, and Maashtur, achieving 600M+ damage at Inspiration 0 and over 1.78B+ at higher Inspiration levels. Key requirements include building at least 150 Resistance on core heroes to resist boss debuffs and tuning Kurvida and Selva to a 15-second rotation for continuous defense penalties. Maashtur utilizes the Secrecy Order set to maximize team Attack and Damage output under shields.

teams.note: Reuses the Dauntless/Vortex setup from Iola. Delivers 600M+ at Inspiration 0 and up to 1.78B+ at full Inspiration when optimized with high Resistance.

meta_changes: Dauntless/Vortex teams built for previous single-target/AoE bosses like Iola remain the premier meta choice for Mekkatorque in Season 8.
tips: Build a minimum of 150 Resistance on Guinavivre, Nastjenka, Selva, and Maashtur to consistently resist Mekkatorque's control and debuffs.
Equip Maashtur with the Secrecy Order gear set to grant additional Attack and Damage boosts while shield buffs are active.
Tune Kurvida and Selva to a 15-second recast rotation (or an 18-second rotation if gear Haste is insufficient) to maintain permanent defense penalties on the boss.
Use Geni (or the Abyssal Starshade Servitor skin) as the deployed familiar for team support benefits.
